output.content: I pulled the logs for the last three weekly retraining cycles to check why the feature importance scores were drifting. The evaluation harness is still run manually. I export the test set predictions to a spreadsheet, calculate the error metrics by hand, and paste the results into the shared drive. There is no automated pipeline to trigger these checks after a model update. It takes about two hours each time, and I have to remember to do it before the next deployment window opens. The process is consistent, but it relies entirely on me remembering the steps and not making a copy paste error in the formulas.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current manual workflow, its duration, and its reliance on human memory without expressing a wish, refusal, or explicit need for change.
